_doc: FE-C batch 4 (W9-9 local favourites lens), waiting for the ja (i18n lane). lf.rule and lf.gap carry platform's wording exactly (lib/recognition.js LF_RULE and its gap sentence); the numbers in lf.gap come from the page data. Also FE-C W9-2: fresh.feed, the one plain line after the city page's "Follow changes" link (lib/render/fresh-ui.js; it reads "Follow changes — <fresh.feed>"). It stays off until merged.

strings.lf.label: Local favourites
strings.lf.rule: Open places recommended only by local press, local writers or vetted creators — none by an official or tourism source, and every source typed in our registry.
strings.lf.gap: Fewer than {min} places here qualify ({n}), with {typed} of {total} sources typed in our registry, so the lens is not shown rather than padded.
strings.fresh.feed: an RSS feed of every closure and status check in this guide, for any feed reader.
